title: What's new in reporting: Layout Management and Report Inbox API's (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction to layout management and report inbox APIs
Layout status feature for controlling layout lifecycle
Layout status menu and lifecycle states
Administrator control and user visibility of layouts
Developer comments and administrator overrides for layouts
Report inbox API capabilities for agents and automation
Discovering report inbox APIs via API overview page

features.name: Layout status control
features.description: Administrators can set a status on report layouts including draft, pending approval, approved, and retired. This extends previous functionality from user-defined layouts to app-supplied layouts including Microsoft-shipped layouts.
caveats: Only affects user visibility; administrators can still run any layout from the layouts page

features.name: Layout lifecycle states
features.description: Report layouts can be transitioned through states: draft, pending approval, approved, and retired. Administrators use the layout status menu on the report layout page to manage these states.

features.name: Layout administrator control of user visibility
features.description: Users only see approved layouts in the report layout control on the request page, while administrators can still run any layout from the report layout page regardless of status.
caveats: Applies only to layout selection by end users; administrators retain full access

features.name: Developer comment override for layouts
features.description: Administrators can override developer-supplied descriptions or summaries for layouts with their own comments, such as 'We don't like this layout' or 'This is not for us', which appear on the report layout page and to users.

features.name: Report inbox APIs
features.description: New APIs enable agents and automation tools to interact with the report inbox, which contains scheduled reports and report packs. Integrations can use Power Platform, MCP servers, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or any tool that speaks APIs.
caveats: Requires integration via APIs; can be accessed via API overview page in version 29

features.name: API overview page for report inbox
features.description: A new API overview page in version 29 provides API names and URLs for report inbox APIs, making them easier to discover and try out.
